prior_evidence: Three consumed research rounds; baseline and top10 events already known. This is retrospective, not blind preregistration or fresh validation.

data_roles.2021-2025: consumed development; hindsight discovery and controls
data_roles.2026: excluded before price calculations; no padding or parameter discovery

available_at: Historical retrieval availability, not realtime arrival. Intraday realtime is realtime per owner.

account.formula: causal Butterworth order1 cutoff1/12; sigma48 ddof0 current; hysteresis k1; exec_pos[i]=signal[i-2]
account.nav: original signed-log index account, 2020 state and boundary interval carried; 2021 NAV reset1

price_attributes.sampling: all14 existing carriers; no locally constructed market bars
price_attributes.filter: first-order Butterworth SOS forward/backward; squared magnitude, zero phase, nonorthogonal, future used. Causal companion uses forward SOS initialized at first value.
price_attributes.edge_exclusion: exclude first/last20 trading days of full <=2025 input from inferential panel; 2020 covers left edge. All original-account events still reported, with edge flags.
price_attributes.daily_sample: last bar of each trading day; trailing windows use native observations_per_day times days; 48primary,46offset. Frequency labels nominal; overnight compressed, irregular coarse views are sparse samplings.
price_attributes.eff: abs(sum close log returns)/sum abs close log returns
price_attributes.rv: sqrt(mean squared close log returns), bp per native bar; daily snapshots
price_attributes.acf: rolling Pearson correlation return[t] versus return[t-lag], window5days
price_attributes.fast_share: sum squared differences of fast component divided by sum of squared differences of five nonorthogonal components; relative variation, NOT orthogonal variance explained
price_attributes.slow_work_velocity: RMS diff L240 / RMS diff (L12-L48), window5days
price_attributes.slow_work_opposition: share of bars with diff L240 and diff work opposite, window5days
price_attributes.work_turns: sign changes in diff work per native day, trailing5days
price_attributes.threshold_work_amplitude: mean original sigma / std(work levels,ddof0), trailing5days
price_attributes.drift_disagree: sign trailing1day netreturn differs from trailing20day netreturn
price_attributes.native_view_audit: efficiency1/5/20days and wick1day for all14; summary/event comparisons only, not a feature search

outcomes: daily log pnl / daily sum abs open returns (capture)
inference.statistic: Spearman rho after within-year centering ranks, all20features x2outcomes
inference.null_1: 1999 independent circular shifts of whole feature panel within each year; shifts at least20tradingdays from0 andyearlength. Retains feature dependence and within-year temporal structure except wrap. Breaks synchronous property-PNL association. Conditional stationarity assumption, not universal chance proof.
inference.null_2: 1999 permutations of consecutive20day feature blocks within year; preserves within-block relations, breaks order and alignment.
inference.multiplicity: two-sided maximum absolute rho over40 tests per surrogate; add-one p. Report unadjusted and maxT adjusted for both nulls.
inference.uncertainty: 1000 year-stratified moving20day paired-block bootstraps, percentile95% CI; overlap remains, no iid bar standard errors
inference.cell_thresholds: pooled dev-panel medians without outcome optimization; descriptive only. Report all4 cells for each, loss/win counts, loss contribution, durations, annual/offset replication.
inference.secondary: yearwise and 5offset Spearman signs, nonoverlap5day block means, causal companion attributes lagged1day. No best feature/policy selection. Causal proxy companion is a separate40test maxT family.
inference.matched_controls: for every primary cell, compare other cells within year x realized-volatility tercile; list counts, pnl/capture differences. Matching is descriptive, not causal identification.
inference.event_selection: all original top10 peak->trough andtrough->recovery; remainder underwater and at/highwater controls; no event-specific threshold tuning

mechanism.trades: completed same-position runs of booked open intervals; exact netreturn, MFE,MAE, favorable-excursion giveback, duration and losses. Includes clipped event trade fragments separately.
mechanism.price_ablations: all7 nonempty subsets of 3 groups {fast=x-L12,medium=L12-L240,slow=L240}; SOSfiltfilt on logopen and logclose separately; reconstruct synthetic O/C, rerun IDENTICAL baseline and threshold, full size. All-groups parity required. Retrospective structural perturbation, not realistic surrogate/null/causal treatment effect; nonorthogonality and boundary artifacts disclosed.

synthetic_wave_grid.open: previous close; no gap; full fixed algorithm; no market calibration

annual_review: Main agent reviews and seals2021,2022,2023,2024,2025 in order, fixed measurements only. No blind claim or annual strategy rebuilding; user scope overrides generic12year skill.
